_description: Fires when someone replies to your Instagram story with a keyword — not on comments.
_use_when: You post a story that says "reply LINK and I'll send it". Create with --story.
_note: Instagram only. Add --story to scope it to one story id, or leave it off to match replies to any story.
name: Story reply — LINK
dmMessage:
Here you go 👇

Thanks for replying — that's the fastest way to get anything from me.
